entries.surface: `capabilities.packs.testMode` — the v2 advertisement of the v1 `/v1/packs-test/*` conformance-seam mirror
entries.authority: spec/v2/core/conformance.md §"The seams profile" (a test-seam capability flag MUST NOT be advertised) + spec/v2/path-manifest.json (no packs path in v2)
entries.note: NOT removed at 2.x. Unlike workflowChainPacks.deferredParameters/hostExpansionSeam (2.8.2), which no host advertised, TWO live v2 discovery documents carry this facet — evidence/v2-host-bundles/myndhyve.json and openwop-host-v2-reference.json — and the v2 root is additionalProperties:false, so removal breaks a published closed record with no host change (COMPATIBILITY.md §2.2; §3's second clause fails because deprecation is available and adequate).

entries.authority: spec/v2/core/conformance.md §"The seams profile" (a `testSeams` capability flag does not exist and MUST NOT be advertised)
entries.note: NOT removed at 2.x. MyndHyve's live v2 discovery document advertises `observability.testSeams: {"otelScrape": true}` (evidence/v2-host-bundles/myndhyve.json), so this is the same closed-record hazard as packs.testMode — not the 2.8.2 zero-bundle case.

entries.authority: RFCS/0237-nondeterminism-sources.md §C (a host that does not offer either family omits it; `false` is not a v2 state)
entries.replacement: presence is the claim (capabilities.md §2); `nondeterminismPolicy.sources` names what is declared
entries.note: NOT removed at 2.x: both are REQUIRED facets, and overview.md §0a predicate 4 retires only optional surfaces; making them optional is an in-place reshape §0a also forbids. v2 only.

entries.surface: the flat v1-era alias keys at the top level of `.well-known/openwop-registry.json` `endpoints` — `registryIndex`, `packMetadata`, `versionManifest`, `versionTarball`, `versionSignature`
entries.authority: RFC 0266 §E.1 (`endpoints` names the v2 tree; the flat v1-era alias keys stay until the v1 installability floor and are deprecated by this row)
entries.note: Born in v2 (RFC 0266 §A.1). The floor is 2027-09-05, 12 months from the 2.0.0 publish (spec/v2/core/overview.md:74); until then the flat keys resolve the v1 tree so 1.x packages stay installable, and after it `endpoints` MAY name only the v2 tree (RFC 0266 §E.2). The registry discovery document is served by openwop-registry; the in-repo sources are the v2 negotiation rule and the published scenario that still reads the flat keys. `kind` is `discovery-field`, the closest existing kind: the surface is a field of a discovery document, the registry's rather than a host's.
